contributions.original_prompts:
New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-kriya-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-kriya-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-kriya.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kriya`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kriya describes Kriya as customer-initiated buy now, pay later for businesses, with UK customers, GB Stripe accounts and GBP presentment and settlement mapping. It lists standard payouts, no recurring, manual capture, disputes, and full and partial refunds. Payment Links, Checkout and Elements are listed, with Checkout setup/subscription and Express Checkout Element excluded. Dashboard enablement and an email request for early access are separately described. The method-page Connect field changes from May No to November Yes, and the access request does not activate an account. A buyer action does not verify payment or external payout (old raw lines 6-86, new raw lines 7-98 and new raw lines 180-184). Both guides describe a withheld disputed balance, a 12-calendar-day evidence deadline and Kriya adjudication. Refunds have a 180-day window and take up to five minutes asynchronously. The Refund object records success or failure, final status can arrive via refund.updated or refund.failed, and failure restores the Stripe balance and requires an alternative refund (old raw lines 134-165, new raw lines 147-178). source-stripe-kriya.md summarizes the May method and refund/dispute terms, but its undated Connect exclusion and comparative claims need correction.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kriya, substantive changes are the method-page Connect change from May No to November Yes, the added email early-access request, and the separate Remote Stored Value Load — Merchant prohibition (old raw lines 36-38, old raw lines 114-132, new raw lines 37-39, new raw lines 69-79 and new raw lines 125-145). Product links, the Elements quickstart target, Markdown and dispute grammar are navigation or presentation changes (old raw lines 58-86, old raw lines 154-156, new raw lines 59-98 and new raw lines 167-169). In source-stripe-kriya.md and the reciprocal Stripe BNPL routes, retain the May method No and its May BNPL overview conflict. November method Yes aligns with the November overview without establishing Connect launch timing, charge-type support, a preview approval or access for a given account. Preserve GBP/UK/GB scope, standard payouts despite headline wording, manual capture and one-time limits, plus dated refund and dispute conditions. The separate BNPL matrix's setup_future_usage cell does not establish recurring payments or SetupIntents, and the linked November acceptance page is navigation for distinct UI/API paths. Neither the early-access request nor buyer confirmation is evidence of a completed payment, refund or bank payout.
